title: Hot Fudge and Salted Chocolate Bits Sundae
changes_from_base: Frozen salted dark-chocolate bits and toasted almonds are layered with coffee and vanilla ice cream under a cream-based hot fudge.
summary: A luxurious layered sundae with salted dark chocolate, two ice creams and a silky hot fudge. The almonds add crunch and sophistication.
equipment: heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water (or microwave)

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Bits
steps.text: Line a pie dish with cling film, melt 225 g finely chopped dark chocolate in a bowl over simmering water or on low in the microwave. Stir in ¾ tsp flaky sea salt, spread 3 mm thick on the film and cover with cling film.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for at least 45 min, then chop into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Fudge
steps.text: Stir together 170 g finely chopped dark chocolate, 180 ml double cream, 3 tbsp light corn syrup or glucose syrup and 2 tbsp caster sugar in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook, stirring, until melted and just simmering, about 5 min.

steps.title: Bubble
steps.text: Let the fudge bubble for 1-2 min more, stirring gently, until rich and glossy.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Scatter 75 g toasted flaked almonds and some of the salted chocolate bits in the bottom of a tall glass.

steps.title: Coffee
steps.text: Add scoops of coffee ice cream, pour some warm fudge over and add more almonds and bits.

steps.title: Vanilla
steps.text: Top with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, more fudge and whipped cream, then finish with almonds and bits.

tips: The salted chocolate bits can be made ahead and frozen until serving.
Make the fudge just before assembling so it is still warm when it goes in.
Serve with a long spoon to reach all the layers.
storage: Keep the salted chocolate bits in the freezer until needed; make the fudge just before serving and assemble the sundaes straight away.
